name: Crowded-short squeeze: deep-negative funding alone (pure positioning long)
rationale: Thesis: when perp funding is DEEPLY NEGATIVE, shorts are crowded and paying longs to stay short — a positioning extreme that historically precedes a short-squeeze recovery in spot. This is the cleanest expression of niche #4: a single positioning gate, no momentum, no sentiment. funding_rate < a fitted DEEPLY-negative floor in [-0.006,-0.0006] (well inside the realized negative tail) arms a long-only spot entry. DISCONFIRMER: must beat a calendar-random long of identical entry-count and identical hold length — if shuffling the entry day to random dates matches net Sharpe, the funding level is noise and this is just 'own crypto'. It must ALSO not be re-derivable as funding-carry: funding_feature is null so NO carry is accrued; the only claim under test is that the crowded-short LEVEL forecasts a squeeze. Low turnover — deep-negative funding is rare (a handful of episodes/year).
catalyst: perp funding flushed deeply negative — crowded shorts paying longs
